info.title: Western blot for a 150 kDa protein

record.procedure: Western blot for a 150 kDa protein

changes.what: Transfer at 30 V overnight instead of 100 V for 1 hour
changes.reason: almost no signal at the expected size; the 150 kDa protein seemed to stay in the gel

record.troubleshooting: Almost no signal at the expected size. Fixed by a longer transfer at lower voltage.
